name: logo-origami
title: Logo Origami
description: A tilted rounded card splits along its middle: the top half folds away while the next logo's lower half flips up, then it rests before cycling again.
use: A small set of client or tech logos should be shown one at a time with a playful swap.
avoid: Only one logo shows at once, so it cannot serve as a full trust wall of brands.
a11y: The cycling cannot be paused, each logo is duplicated in two halves, and reduced-motion is ignored. (keyboard: n-a, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A dark rounded card is tilted slightly back in 3D and crossed by a thin horizontal line at mid-height. A single white logo sits centred, and the halves take different colours as they overlap.
behaves: Every few seconds the top half flips away and the bottom half of the next logo folds up to meet it, briefly showing two logos split across the seam. The card then rests until the next cycle.
customise: duration, delay, className and the children array are props; colours come from each LogoOrigamiItem's className.
weight: light: A handful of DOM halves animate on an interval; idle between flips.
